verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents capturing token usage, model parameters and latency for every request, and its marketing claims real-time tracking of latency, cost and quality. Loop can build dashboards, and the Logs page offers a filterable table of traces. However, the evidence never shows cost and token dashboards broken down by model or by time period. Missing for 10: documented per-model cost/token breakdowns, time-period aggregation in dashboards, explicit per-request cost (not just tokens), independent or hands-on corroboration.
